policy: Real-data model replaces shipped v1.0 ONLY if 5-fold OOF AUC >= 0.65; deterministic WHO/GHS rules remain the runtime fallback.

neonatal_sepsis.external: PhysioNet 2019 adult ICU (n=4000) - out-of-domain transfer check
neonatal_sepsis.training_dataset: REAL: Mbarara RRH neonatal sepsis EMR, Uganda (964 rows [756 positive, 208 negative]; age 0-3 days; vitals + feeding/lethargy signs)
neonatal_sepsis.reason: Real African neonatal EMR (Mbarara RRH, Uganda): OOF AUC 0.90 vs v1.0 simulator 0.74/Brier 0.29; logit-correct Platt restored; probability scale re-anchored to the 2% Ghana prior (prior_adjustment).

robustness.note: Discrimination (ranking) survives class rebalancing. Brier is reported on the target-prior scale (2%); an uninformative model at that prior has Brier 0.0196 (see calibration.prior_adjustment).

preeclampsia_risk.external: UCI Maternal Health Risk (n=868, Bangladesh) - held out
preeclampsia_risk.training_dataset: REAL: cfarkas/preeclampsia_ml ANC cohort, n=190 (maternal age, BMI, gravidity, pregnancy losses)
preeclampsia_risk.reason: Real cohort shows NO discriminative signal on the 5 mappable features (OOF AUC ~0.50 below the 0.65 swap threshold; UCI external AUC 0.35). v1.0 simulator model retained.

lbw_sga.training_dataset: REAL: lbw-classification community study, n=101 (age, Hb only)
lbw_sga.reason: Real cohort maps only 2/11 schema features and shows no discriminative signal (OOF AUC 0.53). v1.0 simulator model retained (documented gap).

child_pneumonia.reason: No public dataset records IMCI clinical signs (cough/indrawing/stridor); v1.0 simulator retained.
